title: Move Don't Delete Tres Idiomas
style: trilingual mid-tempo electronic indie, punchy drum machine, deep sub bass, plucky synth lead, glitchy vocal chops on hook, three-language verse rotation, 102 bpm, clean confident delivery, no swearing
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Don't hit delete, just move it aside
Underscore folder, let it ride
Nothing's gone till the operator says
Move don't delete — that's the way

[Verse 2 — Español]
No borres nada, muévelo no más
Carpeta guardada, todo atrás
Nada se va sin la voz del jefe
Mover no borrar — así se mueve

[Verse 3 — 中文]
Bú yào shān chú, zhǐ yào yí dòng
Fàng zài wén jiàn jiā, bǎo cún bù diào
Cāo zuò zhě kuì, cái néng zuò jué dìng
yí dòng bù shān — zhè shì guī zé

[Chorus — Tres Idiomas]
Move don't delete, mover no borrar, yí dòng bù shān
Keep it alive, mantén vivo, bǎo chí huó
Nothing is lost, nada perdido, shí me dōu zài
The rule is simple, la regla simple, guī zé jiàn dān

[Bridge]
The trash can waits, la basura espera, lè jī děng dài
But only the operator empties it
Pero solo el jefe la vacía
Zhǐ yǒu cāo zuò zhě kě yǐ qīng kōng

[Outro]
Move don't delete, mover no borrar, yí dòng bù shān
Forever, para siempre, yǒng yuǎn
